message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The 24-hour window was 2026-08-03 23:40 UTC through 2026-08-04 23:40 UTC. Confirmed in-scope activity includes 10 Veeam disclosures, 6 Node.js CVE records newly published for the July 29 security release, 1 Firefox advisory, and 2 materially updated Ansible Automation Platform records. Critical Veeam issues make immediate review advisable.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Veeam ONE
- Issue: CVE-2026-64633
- Severity: Critical (CVSS 10.0)
- Summary: An unauthenticated remote attacker can execute code on the agent host.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam ONE through 13.0.2.
- Source: [Veeam KB4892](https://www.veeam.com/kb4892)

**Finding 2**

- Product: Veeam Service Provider Console
- Issue: CVE-2026-58073
- Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.5)
- Summary: An unauthenticated attacker can impersonate a managed agent and obtain that agent's credentials.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam Service Provider Console versions before 9.3.
- Source: [Veeam KB4893](https://www.veeam.com/kb4893)

**Finding 3**

- Product: Veeam Service Provider Console
- Issue: CVE-2026-58072
- Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.0)
- Summary: Arbitrary file writes on the management server can lead to remote code execution.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam Service Provider Console versions before 9.3.
- Source: [Veeam KB4893](https://www.veeam.com/kb4893)

**Finding 4**

- Product: Veeam ONE
- Issue: CVE-2026-58075
- Severity: High (CVSS 8.7)
- Summary: An unauthenticated attacker can read arbitrary host files and may leverage that access for local privilege escalation.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam ONE through 13.0.2.
- Source: [Veeam KB4892](https://www.veeam.com/kb4892)

**Finding 5**

- Product: Veeam Service Provider Console
- Issue: CVE-2026-58067
- Severity: High (CVSS 8.7)
- Summary: An unauthenticated attacker can exhaust host memory and cause denial of service.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam Service Provider Console versions before 9.3.
- Source: [Veeam KB4893](https://www.veeam.com/kb4893)

**Finding 6**

- Product: Veeam ONE
- Issue: CVE-2026-58074
- Severity: High (CVSS 8.6)
- Summary: A highly privileged user can execute arbitrary code on the server.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam ONE through 13.0.2.
- Source: [Veeam KB4892](https://www.veeam.com/kb4892)

**Finding 7**

- Product: Veeam ONE
- Issue: CVE-2026-64631
- Severity: High (CVSS 8.6)
- Summary: A low-privileged user can inject SQL and extract database contents.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam ONE through 13.0.2.
- Source: [Veeam KB4892](https://www.veeam.com/kb4892)

**Finding 8**

- Product: Veeam ONE
- Issue: CVE-2026-64634
- Severity: High (CVSS 8.4)
- Summary: A local attacker can escalate privileges to the Reporter service context.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam ONE through 13.0.2.
- Source: [Veeam KB4892](https://www.veeam.com/kb4892)

**Finding 9**

- Product: Veeam Service Provider Console
- Issue: CVE-2026-58071
- Severity: High (CVSS 8.2)
- Summary: An unauthenticated attacker can access a proxied appliance API as Portal Administrator during a short window after an administrator session starts.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam Service Provider Console versions before 9.3.
- Source: [Veeam KB4893](https://www.veeam.com/kb4893)

**Finding 10**

- Product: Veeam ONE
- Issue: CVE-2026-64630
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 5.3)
- Summary: A low-privileged user can retrieve report data beyond the scope of a shared report link.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly affects Veeam ONE through 13.0.2.
- Source: [Veeam KB4892](https://www.veeam.com/kb4892)

**Finding 11**

- Product: Node.js
- Issue: CVE-2026-56846
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.5)
- Summary: HTTP/2 retained header blocks can evade session-memory limits and enable remote memory exhaustion.
- Relevance: The newly published CVE explicitly affects Node.js 22.x and 24.x.
- Source: [Node.js security release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases)

**Finding 12**

- Product: Node.js
- Issue: CVE-2026-56848
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.5)
- Summary: Re-entrant HTTP/2 processing can cause a heap use-after-free and denial of service.
- Relevance: The newly published CVE explicitly affects Node.js 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x.
- Source: [Node.js security release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases)

**Finding 13**

- Product: Node.js
- Issue: CVE-2026-58045
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.2)
- Summary: A spoofed TypedArray length can crash synchronous node:zlib APIs, enabling denial of service.
- Relevance: The newly published CVE explicitly affects Node.js 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x.
- Source: [Node.js security release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases)

**Finding 14**

- Product: Node.js
- Issue: CVE-2026-58042
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 5.9)
- Summary: DNS responses containing more than 256 A records can abort the process and cause denial of service.
- Relevance: The newly published CVE explicitly affects Node.js 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x.
- Source: [Node.js security release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases)

**Finding 15**

- Product: Node.js
- Issue: CVE-2026-58041
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 5.3)
- Summary: A stale node:sqlite iterator can re-execute a cached statement after it has been reset and rebound.
- Relevance: The newly published CVE explicitly affects Node.js 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x.
- Source: [Node.js security release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases)

**Finding 16**

- Product: Node.js
- Issue: CVE-2026-58044
- Severity: Low (CVSS 3.7)
- Summary: Header truncation in forwarding-proxy patterns can create HTTP request desynchronization.
- Relevance: The newly published CVE explicitly affects Node.js 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x.
- Source: [Node.js security release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases)

**Finding 17**

- Product: Mozilla Firefox for Android / Firefox Focus for Android
- Issue: CVE-2026-18809
- Severity: High (Mozilla rating; CVE enrichment score 6.5 Medium)
- Summary: An information-disclosure flaw was fixed in Firefox 153.0.3.
- Relevance: Mozilla's advisory explicitly lists Firefox, a monitored product family.
- Source: [Mozilla advisory MFSA 2026-73](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-73/)

**Finding 18**

- Product: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Event-Driven Ansible
- Issue: CVE-2026-18141
- Severity: High (CVSS 8.2)
- Summary: A forged HTTP Subject header can bypass mTLS authentication and inject arbitrary events into automated workflows.
- Relevance: The record was materially updated during the window with affected and fixed-build coverage for Ansible Automation Platform 2.6 and 2.7.
- Source: [Red Hat CVE page](https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-18141)

**Finding 19**

- Product: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Event-Driven Ansible
- Issue: CVE-2026-12383
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.5)
- Summary: An exposed EDA endpoint trusts an unverified Subject header, allowing forged mTLS identity and arbitrary event injection.
- Relevance: The record was materially updated during the window with affected and fixed-build coverage for Ansible Automation Platform 2.5, 2.6, and 2.7.
- Source: [Red Hat CVE page](https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-12383)

### Possible matches needing review

- Product relationship: MongoDB ecosystem
- Issue: CVE-2026-48121
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.7)
- Summary: LangChain's third-party `@langchain/langgraph-checkpoint-mongodb` package allowed NoSQL operator injection and cross-tenant checkpoint access through MongoDBSaver.
- Uncertainty: The CVE record was published in the window, but the GitHub advisory dates to May 21 and the affected product is LangChain's package, not MongoDB server, Atlas, Ops Manager, or an official MongoDB-maintained component.
- Source: [GitHub advisory GHSA-98xf-r82g-9mhx](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraphjs/security/advisories/GHSA-98xf-r82g-9mhx)

Immediate review is recommended for Veeam ONE and Veeam Service Provider Console because the set includes unauthenticated remote code execution and credential-exposure paths. Node.js, Firefox for Android, and exposed Event-Driven Ansible deployments should also be reviewed promptly. No other monitored product had a confirmed, in-window match after freshness, product-mapping, and duplicate checks.
